t: This is Holborn Bars, the large red terracotta Victorian building on the north side of Holborn, right at the edge of the City of London. It's also known as the Prudential Assurance Building, and it fills the whole block between Brooke Street, Leather Lane and Beauchamp Street. It was designed by Alfred Waterhouse, the architect behind Manchester Town Hall and the Natural History Museum, together with Paul Waterhouse and Ernest Joseph. Today it is occupied by De Vere Venues, and it's also home to the London office of English Heritage.
